sourcePolicy: Primary evidence only for capability claims; source retrieval is not package approval, installation, live connectivity or source-code security review.

sources.title: Soren source baseline
sources.supportedFinding: Existing eight tools, bundled resources, separate private operations; not proof of deployed state.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.supportedFinding: SKILL.md with optional references/assets/scripts; use progressive disclosure.

sources.title: MCP server concepts
sources.supportedFinding: Tools, resources and prompts have different purposes; preserve declared protocol compatibility.

sources.title: Skills.sh API
sources.supportedFinding: Search, files and audit metadata; Vercel OIDC supported. Audits are not local approval.

sources.title: SkillsMP developers
sources.supportedFinding: Anonymous MCP trial and optional account Bearer key share keyword allowance with REST; respect Retry-After and JSON-RPC quota errors.

sources.title: Anthropic Skills
sources.supportedFinding: Instruction collection; select exact skill, inspect scripts and license before reuse.

sources.title: Official MCP Registry
sources.supportedFinding: Search includes first-party publishers and community wrappers. Registry inclusion is not security review.

sources.title: Vercel Agent Skills
sources.supportedFinding: React performance and UI guidance; select a task-relevant skill rather than loading all.

sources.title: Supabase Agent Skills
sources.supportedFinding: Supabase/Postgres guidance includes queries, schema, connections and RLS; not database credentials.

sources.title: Microsoft Skills
sources.supportedFinding: Azure/Foundry and SDK-oriented skills, agents and configuration examples; do not import all templates.

sources.title: Firecrawl Skills
sources.supportedFinding: Distribution catalog separates core session operations, product/API integration and workflow recipes; mirrors have upstream sources.

sources.title: GSAP Skills
sources.evidenceMethod: First-party repository via Exa and web
sources.supportedFinding: Core/timeline/ScrollTrigger/React/performance instruction sets; preserve an explicit alternative animation choice.

sources.title: Agentic Atlas reference-data pattern
sources.supportedFinding: Author answer-sized records using task vocabulary; retrieve selectively instead of preloading a corpus.

sources.title: Basic Memory Cloud
sources.supportedFinding: Hosted persistent note/context MCP with authorization; separate from public Soren catalog.

sources.title: Exa MCP
sources.evidenceMethod: Official documentation and HAPI exact publisher ai.exa/exa
sources.supportedFinding: Hosted search/content/research MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp; target-client availability must be verified.

sources.title: Firecrawl MCP
sources.evidenceMethod: Official documentation and HAPI exact publisher io.github.firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server
sources.supportedFinding: Hosted web operations; MCP OAuth and API-key endpoints differ. Keep credentials out of URLs/catalogs.

sources.title: Context7
sources.supportedFinding: Resolve a library then retrieve version-relevant documentation; not a software installer.

sources.title: GitHub MCP Server
sources.supportedFinding: Repository/issue/PR/tool integration; use actual scopes and tool discovery before any mutation.

sources.title: Playwright MCP
sources.supportedFinding: Browser tools use structured accessibility state; isolate concurrent profiles. MCP is not a security sandbox.

sources.title: Prefect MCP
sources.supportedFinding: Beta, read-only MCP monitoring and documentation; resource mutations use separately authorized CLI/SDK.

sources.title: DuckDB Python
sources.evidenceMethod: Official documentation and Firecrawl developer index
sources.supportedFinding: Embedded analytical SQL with DataFrame/Arrow interoperability; host execution required.

sources.title: Polars lazy API
sources.supportedFinding: Lazy DataFrame transforms and query planning; separate from MCP and from long-running orchestration.

sources.title: Pandera
sources.evidenceMethod: Official documentation and Firecrawl developer index
sources.supportedFinding: DataFrame validation; support varies by backend. Use data/schema tests rather than visual plausibility.

sources.title: PyArrow
sources.supportedFinding: Columnar data interoperability and formats; not an autonomous analysis or workflow engine.

sources.title: MarkItDown
sources.evidenceMethod: First-party README scraped live by Firecrawl
sources.supportedFinding: Document-to-Markdown conversion with process privileges; narrow converter, file/network limits and isolation required.

sources.title: Crawl4AI
sources.supportedFinding: Programmable web crawling/extraction; use only with authorized runtime and site/crawl budgets.

sources.title: n8n MCP
sources.supportedFinding: Enabled workflows can be accessed/executed; instance-level MCP is user-scoped, not individually scoped per client.

sources.title: Temporal AI
sources.supportedFinding: Durable workflows/activities and human approval patterns; external effects still need idempotency/compensation.

sources.title: GitHub Actions events
sources.supportedFinding: Repository CI and explicit dispatch/scheduling; scheduled delivery is not a real-time availability guarantee.

sources.title: Agentic Atlas contract keystone
sources.supportedFinding: Prose guidance becomes an enforceable contract only when output/effects are actually checked.

sources.title: Agentic Atlas context economy
sources.supportedFinding: Context has quality, cost and latency tradeoffs; no fixture token claim treated as a production benchmark.
